_comment: Help Scout articles that deliberately have NO published page. This is the decision record, not a cache — it is hand-maintained and committed. scripts/ingest-new.js refuses to publish anything listed here, and scripts/report-drift.js reports edits to them separately so nobody goes hunting for a page that was never meant to exist. TO PUBLISH ONE: delete its entry here AND delete its entry from scripts/helpscout-baseline.json — the ingest skips anything already in the baseline, so removing it from this file alone leaves it silently skipped. Then review with `npm run ingest -- --preview .preview --only <slug>` and apply with `npm run ingest -- --write`. Keys are <section>/<slug>, matching data/markdown/ and the baseline.
